profile_text.body:
Apple is a public company founded in 1976 and headquartered in Cupertino, CA, that designs and sells consumer hardware, software, and services. Its website focuses on Apple Intelligence and Siri, which it describes as next-generation AI features coming to iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS Golden Gate, watchOS 27, and visionOS 27. The company describes Apple Intelligence as AI that is integrated into apps, grounded in user context, and private at every step, with Siri AI positioned as a conversational assistant capable of open-ended questions, natural back-and-forth conversation, on-screen visual queries, writing assistance, task automation via Shortcuts, and actions within apps such as Messages, Music, and Reminders. The site notes that Siri AI will launch in beta, will be available in English first, and will not initially be available in the EU on iOS, iPadOS, and watchOS.

Apple's tracked AI products include Apple Intelligence, described as an on-device large language model using Private Cloud Compute and Apple silicon with a privacy-first approach, as well as Final Cut Pro AI and iMovie AI, both of which emphasize on-device processing and Apple silicon optimization for video editing. The company reported revenue of $416,161,000,000 for the period ending September 27, 2025, per its most recent 10-K filing, and trades on a public exchange under the ticker AAPL with SEC CIK 0000320193. Two MCP servers are associated with Apple in the registry: one for managing Apple Ads campaigns and reporting, and one providing Apple Developer Documentation with semantic search, retrieval-augmented generation, and AI reranking.
